weeks.title: Hybrid Hypertrophy
weeks.notes: Illustrative week. Repeat onto your chosen Monday and choose your own working loads.

blocks.title: Preparation
blocks.notes: Easy row or bike for 3–5 minutes. Cat-cow ×6, thoracic rotation ×6/side, scapular push-up ×8. Ramp the first press and pull before working sets.

blocks.title: Chest And Biceps
blocks.notes: Bring dumbbells beside the pec deck if space permits.

items.name: Cable Lateral Raise
items.notes: Repetitions are per side. Complete both sides for each set.

blocks.title: Cable Row And Triceps
blocks.notes: Pair only if both stations are available nearby.

items.name: Cable Chop
